has.review:
Tanushree Das joga khuchuri honestly. A mix of short questions, one word answers, mcqs, blanks, T&F's. (Tip: Don't miss the 1st quiz no matter what. Most of the time, the 1st quiz goes bad as students don't realise what his question pattern actually is like, but you'll get a guide on how the other 2 will be like.)
If you are good at remembering names, information, lines, etc, then you'll easily get good marks by writing the EXACT same thing. If you write some right stuff & a few wrong stuff, then he'll deduct marks. He has a tendency to give less marks in quizzes.

1. CSE499A & 499B are project based course where u need to do only one project in these two courses. That means in 499A u need to select a project and need to complete this in 499B. So basically in 499A, faculties can told u to do some literature review so that u can choose a good project. Only 499A & 499B is connected each other cz 499A is a pre-requisite of 499B. And 498R is totally a different course and is has no relation with 499A & 499B. Because in 499 u just need to do a project and in 498R u need to do research or internship. But if ur target is to going abroad then doing research is good for u.
2. Answered in point 1
3. Internship and research are not a different course. Its course code is CSE498R.
4. It's totally depends on your working progress and faculty. But the ideal time cycle is one semester.
5. You can called capstone as a project showcase fair where u need to show your project which u have done in 499A-B. It's mandatory to attend in the capstone.
I hope I've answered all. If u still don't understand any part feel free to ask.

Kmm sir is a very good teacher for those who follow his instructions accordingly. I believe his instructions are helpful for paper publishing. If you think you won't be able to follow those instructions accordingly, then kmm sir is not for you; my suggestion will go to other faculties. But for CSE 499 kmm, Sir is one of the best we have at NSU; just check out the number of publications he has.

Everyone has papers these days. Just having a paper is no longer enough. It needs to be published in a reputable venue to benefit your career. Often, our undergraduate projects define our core skills and influence our future choices, so it is very important to pick a project/problem that personally interests you.
Any faculty primarily expect regular updates on the project progress and a well written report at the end.

him.review: I am currently doing CSE499A under him.

CSE499A (RTk) - This course can be a life-changing course if you enroll under a faculty member who will guide you in building an excellent project that will both elevate your technical skills and your CV. And, if the faculty pushes you for a publication in a reputed Q1 journal, that's a huge plus point. RTk is one such faculty. Not only does he guide you in choosing an elegant project, but he will be there throughout the entire journey: building the project to writing the research paper, to publishing the paper in a reputed Journal or Conference. When I took this course under him in 2024, all the groups in our section had published a paper based on their CSE499 project. Our paper was published in the Q1 Journal Plos Computational Biology. He is very friendly, supportive, and approachable. However, one thing about him is particularly dangerous: he is very strict with deadlines, meeting his standards, and adhering to academic integrity, including avoiding plagiarism. He will share this detail in the first class. If you fail to give regular, meaningful updates in every class, or fail to meet his deadlines, or plagiarise, he will heavily penalize your marks. He is extremely picky in giving A's. Although this is a group project, your grade depends on your own effort, not that of your group members (every member might get a different grade based on their efforts and contributions). He failed 5-6 students from our CSE499A section and also gave very low grades (D) to some students in CSE499B. So be very careful about that. If you remain consistent on a regular basis and put on honest efforts, you don't need to worry about your grade. You have made a good choice.
